# package rpc

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/rpc"
```

Package rpc implements the connectionless DCE RPC protocol (DCE 1.1 RPC, chapter 12, "CL") that PROFINET IO uses for its acyclic services over UDP: the packet header, fragmentation and reassembly, a client with retransmission and an at-most-once server with a response cache.

The package knows nothing of PROFINET beyond the well-known port; the PNIO interfaces, operations and NDR bodies are in package pnio.


DefaultMaxFragmentBody is the largest body of one packet this package sends: a UDP datagram of 1464 octets (header included), which fits an Ethernet frame without IP fragmentation and matches what PROFINET devices accept.

## Types

### type Activity

```go
type Activity struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

Activity is a client activity of its own: every call on it carries the same activity UUID with increasing sequence numbers, and its calls run one at a time. PROFINET devices tie an application relationship to the activity of its Connect (p-net does), so a controller makes every call of an AR on one Activity.

#### func NewClient

NewClient returns a client that uses conn. When owned is true, Close closes conn.

#### func (Client) Close

```go
func (c *Client) Close() error
```

Close stops the client; calls in progress fail with profinet.ErrClosed.

#### func (Client) Do

```go
func (c *Client) Do(ctx context.Context, addr net.Addr, call Call) (*Response, error)
```

Do performs a call to the server at addr and returns its response.

The request is retransmitted every Retransmit until a response, a fault or the deadline; the server's at-most-once semantics make the retransmissions safe for calls that are not idempotent. A FAULT or REJECT is returned as a \*Fault.

#### func (Client) DoActivity

```go
func (c *Client) DoActivity(ctx context.Context, a *Activity, addr net.Addr, call Call) (*Response, error)
```

DoActivity performs a call on the activity a, waiting for a call in progress on it to complete.

### type ClientOptions

```go
type ClientOptions struct {
	// Timeout bounds a call whose context has no deadline. Zero means 5 s.
	Timeout time.Duration
	// Retransmit is the interval at which an unanswered request is sent
	// again (with the same activity and sequence number, so that the
	// server executes it at most once). Zero means 1 s.
	Retransmit time.Duration
	// MaxFragmentBody bounds the body of one request packet. Zero means
	// DefaultMaxFragmentBody; a value above 65427 (a UDP datagram of 65507
	// octets) is reduced to it.
	MaxFragmentBody int
	// MaxMessage bounds a reassembled response. Zero means
	// DefaultMaxMessage.
	MaxMessage int
	// Activities is the number of calls that can be in progress at the
	// same time; each uses its own activity UUID. Further calls wait.
	// Zero means 4.
	Activities int
	// BigEndian sends requests in big-endian data representation instead
	// of the little-endian one PROFINET devices use.
	BigEndian bool
	// Logger receives diagnostics. nil logs nothing.
	Logger profinet.Logger
}
```

ClientOptions configure a [Client](#type-client).

### type Header

```go
type Header struct {
	Type     PacketType
	Flags1   uint8
	Flags2   uint8
	DRep     [3]byte
	Serial   uint16 // serial_hi << 8 | serial_lo
	Object   UUID
	Iface    UUID
	Activity UUID
	// ServerBoot is the server's boot time; a client sends 0 until it
	// learned it from a response.
	ServerBoot uint32
	// IfaceVersion has the major version in the low 16 bits.
	IfaceVersion uint32
	SeqNum       uint32
	OpNum        uint16
	IfaceHint    uint16
	ActivityHint uint16
	// BodyLen is the length of the body that follows the header.
	BodyLen   uint16
	FragNum   uint16
	AuthProto uint8
}
```

Header is the header of a CL packet. The UUIDs are in canonical order; the integer fields are converted from the packet's data representation.

### type ServerOptions

```go
type ServerOptions struct {
	// MaxFragmentBody bounds the body of one response packet. Zero means
	// DefaultMaxFragmentBody; a value above 65427 (a UDP datagram of 65507
	// octets) is reduced to it.
	MaxFragmentBody int
	// MaxMessage bounds a reassembled request. Zero means
	// DefaultMaxMessage.
	MaxMessage int
	// MaxActivities bounds the activities the server keeps state for.
	// Zero means 64. A new activity beyond it is rejected with
	// StatusServerTooBusy once no idle activity can be evicted.
	MaxActivities int
	// Workers bounds the handlers running at the same time; further
	// complete requests wait for a worker (and are answered WORKING to a
	// ping meanwhile). Zero means 8.
	Workers int
	// ResponseTTL is how long a response is kept to answer a
	// retransmitted request. Zero means 30 s.
	ResponseTTL time.Duration
	// HandlerTimeout bounds one handler call. Zero means 30 s.
	HandlerTimeout time.Duration
	// Logger receives diagnostics. nil logs nothing.
	Logger profinet.Logger
}
```

ServerOptions configure a [Server](#type-server).
